establishedMethods.method: DOLPHOT crowded-field PSF photometry on JWST CAL exposures
establishedMethods.boundary: The exposure-level PSF workflow, alignment, masking, sky estimation, and NIRCam calibration are established; RC69 only pins their exact executable and data lineage.
Input-output residuals, recovery fractions, one row per injection, and retained non-detections are established DOLPHOT practice.
Forced positions and simultaneous scene fitting are established. They are used here as an implementation-independent adjudicator, not presented as a new estimator.

establishedMethods.method: NIRCam PSF simulation and empirical calibration
establishedMethods.boundary: STPSF/WebbPSF and instrument PSF characterization are established; the proposed version/context crossing is a sensitivity test.

specificCombinationUnderTest: Freeze 142 publication identities before running any source detector.
Map those identities to blank, isolated, and many-to-one segmentation states without treating a segment label as a star identity.
Balance 48 environments across collision state, galaxy component, and development/validation split, then retain all 3,072 one-at-a-time injection identities.
Give DOLPHOT and an independently implemented fixed-scene pipeline only the shared CAL hashes, coordinates, and injection ledger.
Require agreement in inclusion and residual surfaces before opening the distance-component statistic.
noveltyBoundary: The reviewed sources establish every constituent technique. They do not establish that this exact target-first collision graph, blocked intervention, independent scene-model adjudication, and sealed distance gate has already been applied to NGC 3447. This is a prior-art search result, not a patentability or priority claim.
